                            G-9 AND G-13 LANDOWNERS’
                   NOTICE OF NOTICE OF HEARING PARTICIPATION

        SOAH Order No. 6 requires parties to confirm how many participants are expected to

attend in-person for the hearing on merits.1 Accordingly, G-9 and G-13 Landowners files this

Notice of Hearing Participation and, in support thereof, shows as follows:

        For the hearing on the merits set for June 9-12, 2026, Thomas Brocato, Jeff Kubin, Tammy

Parnell, and Greg Parnell will attend the hearing in person. Samantha Miller and Tom Ghidossi

will appear via videoconference.




         1

Addressing Hearing Procedures; and Providing Advisory to Intervenors Regarding Potential Dismissal (April 20,
